rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for income received from a source.

example.english: This shop's revenue is pretty good this year.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭今年收入幾好。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 gam1 nin4 sau1 jap6 gei2 hou2

rows.note: Use this for the tax-derived part of government revenue, rather than for all government income.

example.english: The government relies on tax revenue to maintain public services.
example.traditional: 政府靠稅收維持公共服務。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 kaau3 seoi3 sau1 wai4 ci4 gung1 gung6 fuk6 mou6
